observation.command:
cd /tmp
BASE="http://127.0.0.1/qisutu/install.pl"
JAR=/tmp/qisutu-cookies.txt
H="/tmp/step.html"
curl -s -c "$JAR" -b "$JAR" -o "$H" "${BASE}?Step=6"
T=$(grep -o 'name="CSRFToken" value="[^"]*"' "$H" | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
echo "--- POST Finish ---"
curl -s -c "$JAR" -b "$JAR" -o /dev/null -w "http=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST \
  --data-urlencode "Step=6" --data-urlencode "Action=Finish" --data-urlencode "CSRFToken=${T}" "${BASE}"
echo "=== installed.lock ==="
ls -la /opt/qisutu/var/install/installed.lock 2>&1
cat /opt/qisutu/var/install/installed.lock 2>&1
echo "=== QisutuConfig.pm exists ==="
ls -la /opt/qisutu/core/config/QisutuConfig.pm
echo "=== bootstrap removed? ==="
ls -la /opt/qisutu/var/install/ 2>&1
